author: Marvel Entertainment
description:
This week, guest hosts Ryan and Daniel Omoto (Just The Nobodys) guide you through everything you need to know about Marvel Television’s Wonder Man, featuring an exclusive interview with Executive Producer and Head Writer Andrew Guest. Plus, we catch up with Trevor Slattery and explore his journey throughout the MCU. And finally, we go behind the scenes with Casting Associate Leah Shapiro for a real world look at the film and TV casting process.  All time codes approximate.
